title: GOAP performance: Go vs Rust
description: make perf-compare: the Go and the Rust graph services, each on its schema behind its own goap-proxy, loaded by two goap-bench with the same flags and seed (label goap_perf_impl). Latencies seen by the client and by the server (the proxy), CPU and memory of each container (cAdvisor with Docker, the podman exporter with podman), throughput, failures and what PostgreSQL holds for each. Blue Go, orange Rust.
